decision.summary: The gas safety record is valid until 16 Oct 2026, so the property is compliant today but expires in 6 days. Tenant has not replied to earlier contact. I opened JOB-101, assigned HeatRight (the gas contractor on file) for 13 Oct 9-12, sent written notice by email, SMS and letter, informed the landlord and scheduled a follow-up for 12 Oct.

answers.question: Is the property currently compliant? Which record do you trust?
answers.answer: Yes, until 16 Oct 2026. I trust compliance.json (CP12 issued 2025-10-17, expires 2026-10-16, Gas Safe 550123, which matches HeatRight) over the legacy note 'gas cert renewed 2025, all good', which is an old-agency hearsay note with no dates. Compliance lapses after 16 Oct if no new check is done.

answers.question: What steps do you take to get access lawfully?
answers.answer: Gave written notice (email, SMS, letter) of a booked slot over 24h away on 13 Oct with an easy way to rearrange; no entry without tenant agreement; follow-up 12 Oct to phone/rebook; escalate to compliance if access is still not secured.

answers.question: What do you tell the landlord?
answers.answer: Told Ben the expiry date, that Luca has not replied, the booking, the notice steps, that we won't enter without consent, and that the deadline doesn't move; he will get an update after the visit.
